note: One constructor argument. /w/{{app}} in the base URL attributes this app's spend — no custom headers.
code:
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="{{baseURL}}/w/{{app}}/openai/v1",
    api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"],
)

# Chat Completions and the Responses API both route through the gateway.
res = client.responses.create(model="gpt-5.5", input="Why is the sky blue?")
